screen.civitatum.title: Civitatum — character editor
screen.civitatum.name: Name
screen.civitatum.skin_source_hint: The current skin keeps its own colours. A new one uses the prepared skin and eye base.
screen.civitatum.skin_own_hint: The skin colour comes from your current skin.
screen.civitatum.skin_new_hint: The shading of the original texture is kept when recolouring.
screen.civitatum.eye_hint: The upper outline follows the main hair colour. Eye settings apply to a new skin.
screen.civitatum.tail_hint: Three deer tails: short, long and fluffy.
screen.civitatum.no_tail: This race cannot have a tail.
screen.civitatum.height_hint: Height affects the model, the camera, the body size and reach. The range depends on the race.
screen.civitatum.tattoo_hint: Markings lie under the underwear and clothing. Their features depend on the race.
screen.civitatum.beard_hint: Beard and moustache are skin textures. Their colour follows the main hair colour.
screen.civitatum.no_beard_hint: This race cannot have a beard. Of women, only dwarves may choose a beard and moustache.
screen.civitatum.confirm_cosmetic: Only the available appearance details will change.

fml.menu.mods.info.description.civitatum: Race, subrace and sex selection, a character editor, vanilla racial traits and abilities.
birthsign.civitatum.none.name: No birthsign
birthsign.civitatum.none.description: Fate is not yet bound to the stars.
birthsign.civitatum.warrior.name: The Warrior
birthsign.civitatum.mage.name: The Mage
birthsign.civitatum.mage.description: The sign of patient study of the arcane arts.
birthsign.civitatum.mage.effect: +10%% experience gained. With Ars Nouveau: +15%% mana regeneration.
birthsign.civitatum.thief.name: The Thief
birthsign.civitatum.thief.description: Luck favours those who act carefully.
birthsign.civitatum.lady.name: The Lady
birthsign.civitatum.lady.description: The sign of endurance and robust health.
birthsign.civitatum.steed.name: The Steed
birthsign.civitatum.steed.description: Patron of travellers who cannot stand delay.
birthsign.civitatum.lord.name: The Lord
birthsign.civitatum.lord.description: The power of recovery calls for caution near fire.
birthsign.civitatum.lord.effect: Restores 1 HP every 8 seconds at food 6 or more. +25%% fire damage.
race.civitatum.human.name: Human
race.civitatum.human.description: A short life makes humans hurry: they build cities, seek new paths and change the world around them. Among them are warriors, merchants and inventors. In a company searching for the way home, humans rely on resourcefulness and persistence.
race.civitatum.human.positive: Vanilla experience gained +10%%. The usual 20 HP.
race.civitatum.human.negative: No dark vision, natural armour or elemental protection; no separate penalty is imposed on humans.
race.civitatum.human.ability: Focus • for 10 s mining speed +15%%, attack speed +10%%.
race.civitatum.elf.name: Elf
race.civitatum.elf.description: A long-lived people bound to nature, magic and the memory of past ages. Elves cherish the beauty of forests and of their settlements. The loss of their home world means losing a home that many generations believed eternal.
race.civitatum.elf.positive: Choose a subrace to see its traits.
race.civitatum.astral_elf.name: Astral Elf
race.civitatum.astral_elf.description: The ancestors of astral elves wandered the starry void between worlds. Its light remains in their souls and in the glint of their eyes. Now they seek the way to a home that cannot be found on ordinary maps.
race.civitatum.astral_elf.negative: Common to elves: at most 18 HP (9 hearts).
race.civitatum.astral_elf.ability: Star Step • moves to a free point up to 6 blocks along your gaze; does not pass through solid collision.
race.civitatum.dark_elf.name: Dark Elf
race.civitatum.dark_elf.description: Dwellers of underground cities, used to twilight and the dangers of the depths. Their heritage unites the magic of light and shadow. Many have pale hair and greyish skin. A journey beyond their home world opens a sky they are still learning to trust.
race.civitatum.dark_elf.positive: Common: dark vision. Speed +10%% at a light level of 7 or less.
race.civitatum.dark_elf.negative: At most 18 HP. Under the open daytime sky the speed bonus does not apply; there is no separate burning in sunlight.
race.civitatum.dark_elf.ability: Veil of Shadow • Invisibility for 8 s. Taking damage or attacking removes the veil; armour stays visible.
race.civitatum.night_elf.name: Night Elf
race.civitatum.night_elf.description: An ancient people who survived wars that others know only from legends. Night elves guard their sacred lands and keep the memory of the price of past victories. They set out on a new journey so that darkness does not take their home again.
race.civitatum.night_elf.positive: Common: dark vision. Speed +10%% at night in a world with a day cycle.
race.civitatum.night_elf.negative: At most 18 HP. The night bonus does not apply in the Nether and the End.
race.civitatum.night_elf.ability: Moon Watch • gives Glowing to hostile targets within 12 blocks for 6 s; they are visible even through walls.
race.civitatum.wood_elf.name: Wood Elf
race.civitatum.wood_elf.description: Wood elves read tracks, notice changes in the foliage and move where a stranger only breaks branches. They rarely trust outsiders, but the misfortune of their homeland made them leave their forest-hidden settlements.
race.civitatum.wood_elf.positive: Common: dark vision. Speed on the ground +8%%.
race.civitatum.wood_elf.negative: At most 18 HP. The speed bonus does not improve flying or swimming.
race.civitatum.wood_elf.ability: Quiet Step • speed +20%% for 8 s; steps create no STEP vibrations. Attacks, falls and interactions can still be heard by the sculk.
race.civitatum.dwarf.name: Dwarf
race.civitatum.dwarf.description: A people of mountain halls, mines and forges. Dwarves hold on to their clans, their craft and the promises made to their ancestors. Leaving their stone homes for the journey, they take along persistence and the belief that what was destroyed can be rebuilt.
race.civitatum.dwarf.positive: At most 24 HP (12 hearts). Knockback resistance +0.15.
race.civitatum.dwarf.ability: Hard Work • Haste I for 15 s; does not increase resource drops.
race.civitatum.orc.name: Orc
race.civitatum.orc.description: Orc clans value strength, courage and loyalty to their own. Their history is full of raids and feuds, but each orc chooses for himself what to fight for. In a shared company, respect has to be earned by deeds, not by origin.
race.civitatum.orc.positive: At most 22 HP. Melee damage dealt +10%%.
race.civitatum.orc.negative: Damage dealt with vanilla arrows and tridents −10%%.
race.civitatum.orc.ability: Battle Roar • Strength I for 6 s; afterwards speed −10%% for 3 s.
race.civitatum.dragonborn.name: Dragonborn
race.civitatum.dragonborn.description: Humanoids of dragon blood whose scales carry the trace of an ancient heritage. Some serve great dragons, others seek their own path. A journey to an enemy beyond the borders of worlds raises a question for them: what do they owe to their origin, and what do they choose themselves?
race.civitatum.dragonborn.positive: Choose a subrace to see its traits.
race.civitatum.fire_dragonborn.name: Fire Dragonborn
race.civitatum.fire_dragonborn.descripti: Golden, copper and bronze scales keep the heritage of fire dragons. Their breath scorches enemies, but neither the colour of their scales nor ancient blood decides what they will devote their strength to in a strange world.
race.civitatum.fire_dragonborn.positive: Common: natural armour +2. Fire damage taken −25%%.
race.civitatum.fire_dragonborn.negative: Common: exhaustion from ordinary actions +10%%. Freezing damage taken +25%%.
race.civitatum.fire_dragonborn.ability: Fire Breath • a cone of up to 6 blocks, 6 HP of normal damage per target and burning for 3 s. Does not set blocks on fire.
race.civitatum.frost_dragonborn.name: Frost Dragonborn
race.civitatum.frost_dragonborn.descript: Silver and blue scales reveal the heritage of frost dragons. The cold of their breath binds the enemy's movements. Searching for the way home, they rely on endurance and the memory of their kin.
race.civitatum.frost_dragonborn.positive: Common: natural armour +2. Vanilla freezing damage taken −50%%.
race.civitatum.frost_dragonborn.ability: Frost Breath • a cone of up to 6 blocks, 6 HP of normal damage and Slowness II for 3 s. Does not place ice or snow.
race.civitatum.storm_dragonborn.name: Storm Dragonborn
race.civitatum.storm_dragonborn.descript: Amethyst and violet scales recall the dragons of the storm. Their breath carries the power of a discharge. In the lands beyond their home world, this power may become a shield for their companions or a conqueror's weapon.
race.civitatum.storm_dragonborn.positive: Common: natural armour +2. Lightning damage taken −50%%.
race.civitatum.storm_dragonborn.ability: Storm Breath • a narrow beam of up to 8 blocks, 8 HP of normal damage and knockback. A discharge effect without real lightning or fire.
race.civitatum.end_dragonborn.name: End Dragonborn
race.civitatum.end_dragonborn.descriptio: Black scales and violet eyes keep the trace of the dragons of the End. Their breath leaves weakness and gloom. They seek their own path between the heritage of the distant void and life among other peoples.
race.civitatum.end_dragonborn.positive: Common: natural armour +2. Projectile damage taken −15%%.
race.civitatum.end_dragonborn.ability: End Breath • a cone of up to 6 blocks, 6 HP of normal damage and Weakness I for 4 s; violet particles, no dangerous cloud on the ground.
race.civitatum.firbolg.name: Firbolg
race.civitatum.firbolg.description: A secluded forest people who prefer harmony with the living world to the noise of cities. Firbolgs seldom seek battle, but they can defend their lands with weapons and nature magic. The loss of their home made some of them leave their forest refuges.
race.civitatum.firbolg.positive: At most 24 HP. Extra regeneration of 1 HP every 10 s out of combat if food is 10 or more and there is grass or moss underfoot.
race.civitatum.firbolg.negative: Melee damage dealt −10%%; the tall hitbox makes low passages harder.
race.civitatum.firbolg.ability: Strength of the Grove • Regeneration I for 10 s for yourself and friendly players within 5 blocks. Does not heal enemies.
race.civitatum.goblin.name: Goblin
race.civitatum.goblin.description: A small people used to surviving among stronger neighbours. Goblins rely on cunning, quick decisions and knowledge of others' weaknesses. A member of the company may leave the tribe's fear behind and choose for himself what to risk his life for.
race.civitatum.goblin.positive: Speed +10%%. Fall damage −20%%. A small hitbox.
race.civitatum.goblin.ability: Nimble Retreat • a quick step back of up to 3 blocks, checking the whole hitbox along the way; gives no invulnerability.
race.civitatum.forged.name: Forged
race.civitatum.forged.description: Sentient beings of metal, wood and living materials, born for war. They can feel pain and grow attached to others. After their service ends, each has to find a purpose of their own; for some it became the return of the lost home.
race.civitatum.forged.positive: Natural armour +2. Knockback resistance +0.30. Eats metals, by the author's rules.
race.civitatum.forged.negative: Ordinary food is forbidden. Speed −5%%. Ore briefly gives Slowness I.
race.civitatum.forged.ability: Repair Mode • 4 s of standing still, then heals 6 HP. Moving, attacking or new damage interrupts the repair. The cost and cooldown are charged at the start.
race.civitatum.hobbit.name: Hobbit
race.civitatum.hobbit.description: A small people who value the hearth, good food and a quiet conversation. Some hobbits live in peaceful communities, others love the road and new acquaintances. Even on a dangerous journey they keep a clear idea of the home worth returning to.
race.civitatum.hobbit.positive: Saturation from ordinary food +20%%. Fall damage −20%%.
race.civitatum.hobbit.negative: At most 18 HP. Cannot wear boots; the exact message is given on the "Editor" sheet.
race.civitatum.hobbit.ability: Quick Step • speed on the ground +30%% for 8 s; no invulnerability and no jumping through walls.
race.civitatum.orthosian.name: Orthosian
race.civitatum.orthosian.description: Dwellers of harsh, snow-covered Orthois, in whose veins the blood of the Titans is strongest. Brave warriors who do not fear death and skilled inventors who strive to learn the secrets of their ancestors
race.civitatum.orthosian.positive: At most 24 HP. Knockback resistance +0.15. Two-handed weapons in one hand only with a separate patch.
race.civitatum.orthosian.negative: A tall hitbox: you must crouch in two-block passages. The cold of the home world is lore only; the core has no temperature bonus.
race.civitatum.orthosian.ability: Titan's Stance • Resistance I for 8 s, knockback resistance +0.50; speed −20%% for that time.
race.civitatum.algnor.name: Algnor
race.civitatum.algnor.description: A people created by Gerd as the inhabitants of this world. The tribal unions of the Algnors have witnessed every event of this world. Now they are oppressed by the Empire of the Ancients, which has taken their native continent, Algnoris. Many live in the cities of the many descendants of the Titans and have to file down their horns so as not to catch them on door frames. Such Algnors are called City Algnors
race.civitatum.algnor.positive: Choose a subrace to see its traits.
race.civitatum.forest_algnor.name: Forest Algnor
race.civitatum.forest_algnor.description: Forest algnors keep the tribal traditions and the memory of Algnoris. Their horns are not filed down for city doors. Even far from their native lands they remain bound to the forest and to their people.
race.civitatum.forest_algnor.positive: Common: fall damage −20%%. Speed +10%% in vanilla forest and taiga biomes.
race.civitatum.forest_algnor.negative: Common: a tall hitbox and hooves. Cannot wear boots. Outside the forest the speed bonus does not apply.
race.civitatum.forest_algnor.ability: Forest Leap • a jump forward of up to 4 blocks, rising up to 1 block. Real movement with collision, no teleporting through walls. Works without horns too.
race.civitatum.city_algnor.name: City Algnor
race.civitatum.city_algnor.description: Algnors who settled in the cities of the Titans' descendants have grown used to narrow streets and foreign customs. Many file down their horns to move more freely through houses. Life among other peoples has not made them forget Algnoris.
race.civitatum.city_algnor.positive: Common: fall damage −20%%. Experience from vanilla villager trades +20%%.
race.civitatum.city_algnor.negative: Common: a tall hitbox and hooves, cannot wear boots. No forest speed bonus.
race.civitatum.city_algnor.ability: Composure • removes vanilla Weakness and Slowness; speed +10%% for 6 s. Does not cancel racial limitations or curses from mods.
race.civitatum.jahar.name: Ja'Harian
race.civitatum.jahar.description: An arrogant and powerful race from the world of Ja'Haar. Their skin is pale, and the irises of their eyes give off a faint white light. Their homeland is a desert, mired in endless wars and strife by which their people live. They worship the Renegade Gods, who gave them their powers, which also became their curse. Though the Ja'Harians gained power, they paid a high price for it.
race.civitatum.jahar.positive: Regeneration: 1 HP every 4 s out of combat if you are not burning and food is 6 or more; each 1 HP costs 2 exhaustion.
race.civitatum.jahar.negative: Fire damage +25%%; afterburn hurts twice as often. A death by fire permanently takes 2 maximum HP, down to 4 HP.
race.civitatum.jahar.ability: Echo of the Gift • a beam of up to 6 blocks at one hostile target: 6 HP of normal damage; on a hit heals the owner by 2 HP, no higher than their reduced maximum.
